title: Earthy Canadian Dried White Corn Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Canadian dish featuring dried white corn and beurre-monte, perfect for a midnight craving. This shojin-friendly stew is cooked to perfection in a Dutch oven.
instructions: Heat the beurre-monte in the Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the rehydrated dried white corn, chopped carrot, and chopped potato, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour in the vegetable broth, dried thyme, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Remove the Dutch oven from the heat and let the stew cool slightly before serving.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
